findings.title: Cleanup removes a literal nonexistent alias instead of the created IDP
findings.body: The cleanup callback is registered against `get("alias")`, rather than the `alias` value created in this loop (`idp-alias-0` through `idp-alias-19`). Consequently none of the IDPs created by this test are removed during cleanup (and the cleanup may issue failing deletes for a nonexistent provider named `alias`). The same problem is repeated for `idp-alias-20` at line 425. Register cleanup using the actual alias for each created provider.
